texts.preamble: Oms Sivajothi Mills vs The Authorized Officer on 15 July, 2015 Author: T.Raja Bench: T.Raja In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 15.07.2015 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice T.Raja W.P.No.21281 of 2015 Oms Sivajothi Mills rep by is Partner R.J.Mahesh Babu .. Petitioner -vs- 1. The Authorized Officer Chennai Sea Port and Air Port Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Ministry of Health and Family Welfare Southern Regional Office Chennai Fort Trust Building Rajaji Salai, Chennai 2. The Deputy Commissioner of Customs New Custom House Gst Road Meenambakkam, Chennai .. Respondents Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying for the issue of a Writ For Petitioner :: Mr.S.Lakshmanasamy For Respondents :: Mr.A.P.Srinivas Standing Counsel Order
texts.facts: When the same reached the office of the respondents, they had taken samples and sent them to the laboratory for testing. Subsequently, after the testing was over, the petitioner was informed that the goods imported by the petitioner from Myanmar are not in accordance with the standards prescribed under the Food Safety and Standards Act and Rules and it was also informed that the goods have more minerals. But it is the claim of the petitioner that the imported goods do not contain more minerals. However, as there is no machinery to clean all the imported goods, the petitioner approached the respondents with a request to grant them permission to wash and clean the goods in the presence of the officers in view of the circular dated 20.1.2012 bearing No.1-17/FSSAI/T/2010. But, for the reasons best known to them, the petitioner was not permitted to wash and clean the goods to enable them to take fresh samples for testing.
texts.arguments: This writ petition has been filed by M/s OMS Sivajothi Mills represented by its Partner Mr.R.J.Mahesh Babu seeking a mandamus directing the respondents to permit the petitioner to wash and clean the raw black matpe, which was imported by the petitioner from Myanmar and to Oms Sivajothi Mills vs The Authorized Officer on 15 July, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120340015/ 1 pass further orders. 2. 3. It has been claimed by the petitioner that they have imported raw black matpe from Myanmar.
